A system of equations in three variables is useful in solving applications when the problem describes three unknown quantities. It is also used in curve fitting problems, such as determining the equation of a parabola or a circle that passes through given points. Systems of three equations can be solved with a variety of methods, but in this Learn It, we will solve systems using elimination.
When devising your plan, be sure to do the following.
Select three different variables to represent the three unknown quantities.

Form three equations involving each of the variables. Consider writing verbal sentences, drawing a sketch, or making a chart to better understand the relationships between the unknowns and the given information.
